note:
Reviewed CDB90 match 122, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: BR & PORT ARMY remains combined and local; FR ARMY maps to the existing First French Empire.

The National Army Museum documents the British infantry component of this Peninsular War army. That component supplies the existing shako-and-musket analogy while the complete British/Portuguese/Spanish or allied CDB 90 designation remains intact; the model does not assign British dress to the whole coalition. The model is a representative infantry component, not an exact regimental uniform or a statement that every soldier used that equipment. Coalition identities, component proportions, CDB 90 personnel evidence and all loss categories remain unchanged.
